name: 🔥 Voxforge ⚔️ RPG
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Voxforge!

RUNES UPDATE: INFUSE LEGENDARY UNVEILED RUNE WITH A WEAPON FOR MASSIVE POWERS! ⚖️

Explore diverse biomes, from Overgrown Valleys and Autumn Forests to sky-piercing mountains and primordial caves! 🗺️

⚔️ Fight dangerous enemies
🧰 Collect powerful gear
🌎 Discover hidden locations
📜 Uncover the world's mysteries

Premium players receive +20% Gold.

Make sure to 👍 and ⭐ to Continue Voxforge's rapid Growth! 🌲

Dash - Q / Button B / Circle
Sprint - CTRL / Left Stick (L3)
Shiftlock - SHIFT / DPad Down
Inventory - E / Button Y

⚙️ Voxforge is currently in Alpha. Expect changes and content expansions.
